children.value: > Fact From Story hotter-than-expected inflation data raised the prospect of another interest rate rise at the Reserve Bank’s next meeting, which would weigh on the equity market.
> > Fact From Story Interest-rate sensitive sectors, including REITS and consumer companies, were among the weakest on the local bourse as investors digested the news.
> > > Fact From Story Interest-rate sensitive sectors, including REITS and consumer companies, are sensitive to changes in interest rates.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A rise in interest rates increases the cost of borrowing, which can negatively impact companies in interest-rate sensitive sectors.
> > Commonsense Knowledge An interest rate rise is considered negative news for interest-rate sensitive sectors.
> Fact From Story the benchmark S&P 500 index closed 0.7 per cent higher ahead of tech giants Microsoft and Google’s parent company Alphabet reporting their results after the close.

> > Fact From Story Shares in Microsoft climbed 5 per cent in after-hours trading after the tech company said its sales jumped 13 per cent to $US56.5 billion ($88.9 billion) and profits climbed 27 per cent to $US22.3 billion in the three months through September.

> > > Fact From Story Google, which is also seeking to capitalise on surging demand for AI technology, saw revenue climb 11 per cent to $US76.7 billion, with net income of $US19.7 billion thanks to a recovery in digital advertising revenue.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Strong revenue and income performance by major tech companies like Google can positively influence the S&P 500 index.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Positive earnings reports often lead to an increase in a company's stock price.
> Commonsense Knowledge Generally, a market will react negatively to the prospect of an interest rate rise.
